variants.title: Melde's experiment: a 256 Hz fork, transverse arrangement
variants.sample: 256 Hz electrically maintained fork (scientific pitch C)
variants.note: A higher fork makes shorter loops: ten loops stand along the thread at about 73 g.

source.title: Scientific pitch: C = 256 Hz, its lower octave 128 Hz (standard tuning-fork set)

variants.aim: Drive a thread with a 256 Hz fork across it, change the load until a whole number of loops stands, and find the frequency from the tension and the loop length.

variants.title: Melde's experiment: a 128 Hz fork, longitudinal arrangement
variants.sample: 128 Hz electrically maintained fork (scientific pitch C one octave below 256 Hz)
variants.note: With the fork along the thread the thread moves at the fork's own frequency, so twice as many loops fit as in the transverse arrangement for the same load.

source.title: Scientific pitch: C = 256 Hz, its lower octave 128 Hz (standard tuning-fork set)

variants.aim: Drive a thread with a fork along it, change the load until a whole number of loops stands, and find the fork frequency from the tension and the loop length.
